biotools.summary: LOVD for GDPD1 is a database and web application providing variant information for the Glycerophosphodiester Phosphodiesterase Domain Containing 1 (GDPD1) gene, used to identify and characterize structural variants linked to retinitis pigmentosa type 17. The platform facilitates data submission and analysis for researchers and clinicians.
